spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  date as time, total_bias
FROM
  "Daily_Mean_G_R"
WHERE
  product_r='$product_r'
  AND product_g='$product_g'
  AND (radar='$radar' OR radar IS NULL)
  AND ABS(min_availability-$min_availability)<0.0001
  AND ABS(min_precip_rate-$min_precip_rates)<0.0001
  AND date >= $__timeFrom()
  AND date <= $__timeTo()
  AND n_pixels >= $min_n_pixels 
ORDER BY date
